title: Lost laptop
text: Report a lost laptop to the IT service desk immediately. Include the asset tag if known. Do not send passwords in the report.

title: Password reset
text: Use the internal password reset portal. If the portal is unavailable, contact the IT service desk. Never share a password or one-time code with another person.

title: Printer support
text: For a printer fault, note the printer asset tag and the displayed error code. Send those details to the IT service desk. Do not dismantle the printer.

title: Guest Wi-Fi
text: Visitors request guest Wi-Fi access from reception. Guest access expires at the end of the visit. Staff must not share their own network credentials.
